Agriculture, Forestry and Water Economies.] With an 11% share in the GDP, agriculture is

the third biggest sector in the economy,

following services and industry. In 2011, the

sector provided employment to 18% of the

workforce. Around 41% of the country's land area

is agricultural land, of which one half is arable

land. The land is very fragmented, with an average

size of the private farms of approximately 1.7 ha

and scattered in 1-3 plots. This leads to an

inefficient use of the farm land. The total arable

land has been decreasing, caused by migration of

the population from villages to the cities and

exploitation of the land for urban purposes and

other non- agricultural activities.
